newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins 985 mln SKR Malaysia order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins 985 mln SKR Malaysia order.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Wednesday that it had won a 985 million crown contract from Malaysia's Mutiara Telcommunications Sdn Bhd to further expand its nationwide personal communications network (PCN).
The order is an addition to an earlier $355 million order, Ericsson said in a statement.
"We currently have 130,000 subscribers on the Mutiara DiGi1800 network, which makes us the largest PCN operator in Malaysia," Mutiara chairman Kamaruddin Jaffar said in an Ericsson statement.
"This order will further improve the capacity of the network to accomodate 400,000 subscribers."
The order includes switching, radio base stations and transmission equipment, the company said.
Mutiara Telecom was the last of five operators in Malaysia to receive a license for digital telephony based on the GSM/PCN standard in mid-1994 and was the first to commercially launch the system.
